thread:
alex: CI red on main — integration-tests failing across multiple runs with KMS decrypt errors. saw a bunch of `403`/`AccessDenied` in the runner logs. anyone seen this before?

maya: yep saw the same. looks like the gha service token couldn't decrypt secrets for the test harness. full log: `kms:Decrypt AccessDenied`

sam: Confirmed. Also noticed one runner produced `token expired` for the repo deploy key, others had `AccessDenied`. Could be a transient KMS policy change or the key rotated.

jen: before we start bisecting, can someone check vault/kms audit logs? If a binding was removed we'd see it in the audit trail. ops-bot, any events?

ops-bot: event: KMS key: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/runner-key — IAM: RemoveBinding by iam-admin@redwood.com @ 2026-03-17T09:12:03Z

alex: that matches timeframe of the first failing job. who removed it?

maya: pinging infra-iam owner. in the meantime, can we rerun the failing job? If it's a perm flap rerun won't help but if it was transient maybe.

ci-bot: Job queued: integration-tests (PR #3121). trigger: @alex. Use `/ci rerun integration-tests` or run `./scripts/ci rerun --job integration-tests --pr 3121` in console.

sam: I'll request a manual rerun but watch rate limits. Also we should bisect to see minimal commit that triggers secret usage change. Quick bisect command: ```bash
git bisect start -- HEAD good-commit
git bisect bad commit-sha
git bisect run ./scripts/run_integration.sh
```

jen: also check repo deploy key TTL/rotation — saw `token expired` on one runner. Ops, can we re-add the IAM binding temporarily?

ops-bot: Temporary restore performed by iam-admin@redwood.com: AddBinding on KMS key — success. Reason: unblock CI.

alex: rerun kicked off. I'll watch it. If it passes we'll still need a follow-up to audit long-lived keys and rotate.

ci-bot: Job status: integration-tests — run #4567 — PASSED. Duration: 12m 24s.

maya: nice. looks like transient removal. still want an official root cause and change to avoid human-removal mistakes.

sam: opening infra ticket: INFRA-4827 "KMS binding accidentally removed — CI unblocked but need guardrails". Assigning to iam-admin, tagging security and eng-sre.

jen: action items: 1) add a policy to prevent direct binds removal without review (IAM condition or approval workflow), 2) rotate the deploy key to short TTL, 3) add monitoring alert on `kms:Decrypt AccessDenied` spikes.

alex: agree. for now CI unblocked and PR green. posting the rerun command I used for reference: `./scripts/ci rerun --job integration-tests --pr 3121 --watch`

maya: thanks all. leaving notes on the PR and linking INFRA-4827. :thumbsup:

alex: closing thread — will follow up once ticket has a timeline.
